stageContract: Entry eligibility while flat only, never a holding target or exit. Coordinator supplies a causal frozen baseline and applies execution delay once. Every gate requires baseline[i] and i>=90.

BTC/USD.name: BTC unchanged normalized weekly eligibility
BTC/USD.economicHypothesis: Control: preserve every supplied weekly long-state entry opportunity.
BTC/USD.lineage: Current 40-native-week BTC trend; this function does not reconstruct or change its baseline.

BTC/USD.name: BTC directional path-quality gate
BTC/USD.equation: eligible_i = baseline_i AND i>=90 AND (C_i-C_(i-28))/sum_(j=i-27..i)|C_j-C_(j-1)|>=.35 AND C_i/C_(i-28)-1>baseRoundTripGross
BTC/USD.economicHypothesis: Within the slow bullish regime, avoid entries whose recent price displacement is small relative to its traveled path and costs.
BTC/USD.lineage: Signed Kaufman-style efficiency ratio; established indicator gate, not new mathematics.
BTC/USD.failure: Strong trends can begin after noisy paths; historical displacement is not a forecast of remaining return.

BTC/USD.name: BTC pullback recovery crossing gate
BTC/USD.equation: E_i=(2/11)C_i+(9/11)E_(i-1), E_0=C_0; eligible_i=baseline_i AND i>=90 AND C_(i-1)<=E_(i-1) AND C_i>E_i AND max(C_(i-19)..C_i)/C_i-1>=.02
BTC/USD.economicHypothesis: Enter only after a local pullback starts recovering while the slower weekly regime remains eligible.
BTC/USD.lineage: Established trend-conditioned pullback and crossing event; one fixed application.
BTC/USD.failure: May miss uninterrupted rallies; the rebound can fail and later fill prices can erase apparent entry improvement.

ETH/USD.name: ETH unchanged ETH40 eligibility
ETH/USD.economicHypothesis: Control: preserve every supplied ETH40 long-state entry opportunity.
ETH/USD.lineage: Current frozen daily ETH40 hysteresis; no redefinition of its original target.

ETH/USD.name: ETH cost and volatility confirmation gate
ETH/USD.equation: r_j=log(C_j/C_(j-1)); sigma_i=sqrt(sum_(j=i-19..i)r_j^2/20); TR_j=max(H_j-L_j,|H_j-C_(j-1)|,|L_j-C_(j-1)|); eligible_i=baseline_i AND baseline_(i-1) AND i>=90 AND log(C_i/C_(i-5))>max(baseRoundTripLog,sqrt(5)*sigma_i) AND TR_i<=2*mean(TR_(i-20)..TR_(i-1))
ETH/USD.economicHypothesis: Require short-term confirmation scaled by the asset's recently observed fluctuations, while excluding isolated large range shocks.
ETH/USD.lineage: Established volatility-normalized momentum and shock filtering; fixed composite entry gate.
ETH/USD.failure: The scale is RMS return, not a calibrated standard error or confidence test; it can reject the beginning of a successful large breakout.

ETH/USD.name: ETH volume-pressure confirmation gate
ETH/USD.equation: CLV_j=(2*C_j-H_j-L_j)/(H_j-L_j), zero when H_j=L_j; pressure_i=sum_(j=i-27..i)(CLV_j*V_j)/sum_(j=i-27..i)V_j; eligible_i=baseline_i AND i>=90 AND pressure_i>.15 AND C_i>C_(i-1)
ETH/USD.economicHypothesis: Require native-venue volume-weighted close location to support the ETH40 bullish target.
ETH/USD.lineage: Reuses the earlier eth_volume_pressure_v1 entry statistic unchanged, now solely as an ETH40 entry gate; not a new primitive method.
ETH/USD.failure: A volume-weighted close location is not signed order flow; one venue may not reflect the global market.
